name: Progress-19
about: Progress-19 (1984-018A), a crewed vehicle (Progress), launched 1984 Feb 21. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1984 Mar  5), held fixed
docked to S13138; it stays docked here until its end of mission (GCAT psatcat TDate), when it burns up; the undocking and deorbit burn are folded into that (a fudge of up to a few days)
GCAT gives the end of mission (psatcat TDate) without an hour

events.why: GCAT gives the end of mission without an hour
